company.shortDescription: Bubbl Widget is a social networking software that focuses on your immediate group and creative contributions.
company.description: Bubbl is a widget that displays live text feeds from your favorite pals right on your Home Screen. You and your best pals will see each other's thoughts and statuses every time you unlock your phone. It's a small insight into what everyone is up to throughout the day.

productsAndServices.description: A widget that displays live text feeds from close friends directly on the user's home screen, allowing users to see each other's thoughts and statuses throughout the day.
